create_MujocoEnv_subclass: create a subclass of MujocoEnv that implements get_obs_dict and get_reward_dict for a custom MuJoCo environment
run_get_sim: run get_sim to create an MjSim instance from a model XML file path or XML string
test_MujocoEnv_step: test the MujocoEnv step method by passing an action and verifying observation and reward returns
visualize_policy_MujocoEnv: visualize a policy running in a MuJoCo environment by calling visualize_policy with a policy object and horizon
review_MujocoEnv_reset: review the MujocoEnv reset method to understand how initial qpos and qvel states are restored
